factsChecked: DATE-valued DTSTART with explicit DTEND requires DATE end; DTSTART inclusive and DTEND non-inclusive.
DATE DTSTART with neither DTEND nor DURATION lasts one day.
Date-only values and UTC midnight timestamps are different representations, with no blanket provider import guarantee.

factsChecked: Bare DATE-TIME without Z or TZID is floating, regardless of other VTIMEZONE components.
Trailing Z is UTC; local DATE-TIME plus TZID references a zone. Numeric UTC offset suffix is not a permitted DATE-TIME form.
Fixed-offset examples are deliberately not asserted as a city DST table or complete VTIMEZONE file.

sourceReferences.supportingSourceParaphrase: Defines local floating, UTC, and local-with-zone forms and rejects numeric UTC offsets in DATE-TIME values.

details: 09:00UTC plus02:00=11:00local.
09:00UTC plus09:00=18:00local.
Floating09:00 remains09:00local in each recipient zone, implying different instants.

STATUS must be CANCELLED for entire-event cancellation and must be omitted when only uninviting specific attendees.
Familiar fields are not authentication; diagnostic article correctly avoids asserting arbitrary local delete sends provider cancellation.

factsChecked: DTSTART counts as first occurrence; COUNT and UNTIL cannot co-occur in one RRULE.
UNTIL inclusive and matches DTSTART value type; UTC or zone-referenced DTSTART requires UTC UNTIL.
EXDATE removes generated starts and takes precedence; it does not replenish COUNT.

sourceReferences.supportingSourceParaphrase: Defines mutually exclusive COUNT/UNTIL, inclusive boundary, DTSTART counted first and required time basis.
Final recurrence set excludes EXDATE after inclusion generation, with exclusions taking precedence.
